# Invitations

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** api + web  
**Status:** shipped

## Purpose

How a colleague gets into a clinic. Issue, revoke, resend, and an unauthenticated accept page.

## Features

- Token hashed at rest, same treatment as a refresh token
- Invitation carries the role and the branches it will grant
- Revoke and resend
- Unauthenticated `/join` page that creates the user, membership and role grant on accept

## User actions

- Invite someone by email or phone, choosing role and branches
- Revoke or resend a pending invitation
- Accept an invitation and set a password

## Known limitations

- Delivery is the same logging stub as OTP — the invitation link is only visible in the API logs
- No expiry sweep; expired invitations are filtered at read time, never deleted
